## Orientation

Work in /home/ayin/se-workflow on branch feat/dashboard-ui, after status-tabs commit 75e530c. Code is scripts/dashboard_app.py and the dashboard model in scripts/; tests are tests/test_dashboard_app.py and tests/test_dashboard_model.py. Another session edits tests/test_dashboard_app.py, tests/conftest.py and tests/helpers.py in a separate worktree: keep test edits small and local, do not refactor shared fixtures. Run only touched tests with -k during work; run the acceptance command once at the end. Write failing tests first. You are the only executor. Do not push.
